mapper.insert: INSERT INTO edudoc_template_version (id, template_id, version_no, source_object_id, validation_status, change_summary) VALUES (HEXTORAW(#{version.id}), HEXTORAW(#{version.templateId}), #{version.versionNo}, HEXTORAW(#{version.sourceObjectId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{version.validationStatus}, #{version.changeSummary, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.sql: RAWTOHEX(v.id) AS id, RAWTOHEX(v.template_id) AS templateId, v.version_no AS versionNo, RAWTOHEX(v.source_object_id) AS sourceObjectId, v.validation_status AS validationStatus, RAWTOHEX(v.published_by) AS publishedBy, TO_CHAR(v.published_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS publishedAt, v.change_summary AS changeSummary
mapper.select: SELECT FROM edudoc_template_version v WHERE v.id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId})
SELECT MAX(v.version_no) FROM edudoc_template_version v WHERE v.template_id = HEXTORAW(#{templateId})

SELECT , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM edudoc_format_rule r WHERE r.template_version_id = v.id) AS ruleCount FROM edudoc_template_version v WHERE v.template_id = HEXTORAW(#{templateId}) ORDER BY v.version_no DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE edudoc_template_version SET validation_status = #{validationStatus} WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId})
UPDATE edudoc_template_version SET published_by = HEXTORAW(#{publishedBy}), published_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE id = HEXTORAW(#{versionId}) AND published_at IS NULL
